/.summary: Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets. Find BVSc & AH notes, books, objective questions and clinical references by year.
faq: Are the resources hosted here?
Notes.ThatVetGuy organises links to credited external sources. Availability, downloads and access terms belong to each source.
Where should I start?
Choose your professional year in BVSc Notes & Books, or search for a subject, book or clinical reference.

/bvsc/.summary: Free notes, books and practical material for all four BVSc & AH professional years. Choose your year, then your subject.
faq: Does this grouping match my university?
Year grouping may vary by university. Check your syllabus before planning revision.
Where do the files open?
File buttons open the original Google Drive viewer. Download is available only for known binary files below 25 MB.

/objective/.summary: Objective notes and veterinary question banks for BVSc & AH revision. Browse Dhruv N Desai, Animal Science Refresher, TANUVAS and more, with direct Telegram access.
faq: What is in this collection?
Five objective revision resources and five question banks, with the resource names, descriptions and Telegram links shown on the page.

/study-tools/.summary: Explore practical AI study guidance, useful free apps and everyday study tools for veterinary students. Use the guides to organise reading, references and presentations while checking veterinary information against trusted sources.
faq: Can I use AI as a clinical reference?
Use AI to help organise study. Check facts, citations and drug information against original professional references before relying on them.
Do these guides require subscriptions?
The guides describe study habits and tools by name. They do not require signing up or following external software links.

/search/.summary: Find veterinary notes, books and practical material by topic, subject or year. Search the whole collection or start with a suggested topic.
faq: Can I browse without JavaScript?
Yes. The four Try links lead to static topic results, and each category has a complete HTML listing. Full query matching requires JavaScript.

/about/.summary: Notes.ThatVetGuy is a free academic library for BVSc & AH students. Find notes, books and practical material by year, with study guides to help you choose what to read next.
faq: Where do resources open?

Topic-wise notes open on Google Drive. Objective notes, question banks, drug references and handbooks open in Telegram; some collections require access. Recommended books do not always have a linked copy. Original authors retain credit.
Does the year grouping match my syllabus?
Year grouping may vary by university. Check your syllabus before planning revision.

/request-resource/.summary: Request a veterinary note, book, PYQ or useful study resource, or report a link that needs attention. Include the subject, year and source so the library can be improved for other veterinary students.
faq: How do I report a broken link?
Email contact@thatvetguy.net with the page URL and resource name. The visible email address can be copied if your email application does not open.
Can I contribute a resource?
Send the original source, title and subject to contact@thatvetguy.net. Share material you have permission to contribute.
